- 61fe87c7 "Each month stands alone: the fee of one billing month is calculated from that month's registered vehicles" — derivation of "for each month in which the site carries more registered vehicles than its permit-free allowance"; no new semantics.
- 0eb6c758 "The first row governs whenever the restriction or a rent balance owing is present, whatever the tenure or the returned payments" — restates the ladder order.
- 7838922e / 1efadecf / a335f2e7 "as its status shows in the system's records" / "read from the system's records … not from the resident's own account" — renders `evidence_contract.authority: system_record`.
- 830e596a "The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it" — tool owner semantics (user-owned), consistent with the runtime schema.
- Threshold tables and hypothetical cases in every factor doc reproduce the ladder at its boundaries; none adds a tier or changes a boundary.

Additions found: none (no confirmation, review, notification or failure procedure absent from the source).
Prerequisite-side specific checks: (1) cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, call …") — none; each tool name appears only in its own policy's hub. (2) A task's opening world state written as a policy fact — none; all examples are labelled hypothetical and use figures that are not task 0's (e.g. $47.00 permit fees, $22.50 plan figure).
